batches.source: os.urandom(8) per seed, little-endian, the top bit cleared (63 bits); a draw below 2**32 or a duplicate drawn again

runs.results: the per-run records (<draw>.json, .summary.json, .stderr): the maintainers' run folder on apollo, not shipped
runs.note: 24 containers, one per candidate, 16 at a time (the last 8 as slots freed), each --network none, --cpuset-cpus 32-47 --cpus 1 --memory 8g (the verifier's OpenBLAS thread count: 2); from 04:37Z beside the camera-only localisation runs of the maintainers (perception2, 6 jobs on cores 40-47)

amendments.what: the agent cameras' renderer (render only; the owner's request of 2026-11-07, the OVRTX light baked into Filament): the colour from MuJoCo's Filament renderer on a render twin of the cell in the dressed factory hall (tests/shoecell/look.py), the depth from the classic renderer on a depth twin (the cell's own geometry plus the hall); the rig gets the scene (physics.py: one argument); the cell manual says what the cameras see (given_hashes.json); the image adds Mesa's lavapipe and the render bundle (environment/Dockerfile). The physics model, the reference and the scoring are unchanged: the reference's privileged run reads two frames, the random generators of the scene and of the sensor noise are untouched.

check.rule: the reference's full verify of the fixed set on the amended image (tests/review/regrade.sh) repeats every kept selection run: the same work_score, simulated time, ticks and per-pair detail (tests/anchor.json, verifies)
